mapper.sql: SELECT id, policy_key, version, environment, CAST(match_json AS CHAR) AS match_json, action_type, CAST(action_params_json AS CHAR) AS action_params_json, risk_limit, auto_execute, approval_required, max_duration_seconds, status, created_by, based_on_policy_id, change_reason, content_sha256, submitted_at, approved_by, reviewed_by, reviewed_at, decision_reason, retired_at, retired_by, created_at FROM response_policy
mapper.select: WHERE policy_key=#{policyKey} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO response_policy (policy_key, version, environment, match_json, action_type, action_params_json, risk_limit, auto_execute, approval_required, max_duration_seconds, status, created_by, based_on_policy_id, change_reason, content_sha256) VALUES (#{policyKey}, #{version}, #{environment}, #{matchJson}, #{actionType}, #{actionParamsJson}, #{riskLimit}, #{autoExecute}, #{approvalRequired}, #{maxDurationSeconds}, 'draft', #{createdBy}, #{basedOnPolicyId}, #{changeReason}, #{contentSha256})
mapper.update: UPDATE response_policy SET status='pending', submitted_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{id} AND status='draft' AND created_by=#{actorId}
UPDATE response_policy SET status='retired', retired_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), retired_by=#{actorId} WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('draft','pending') AND created_by=#{actorId}
UPDATE response_policy SET status='retired', retired_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), retired_by=#{actorId} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='active'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (occurred_at, actor_type, actor_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, request_id, outcome, reason, after_hash) VALUES (#{occurredAt}, 'human', CAST(#{actorId} AS CHAR), #{action}, 'response_policy', CAST(#{policyId} AS CHAR), #{requestId}, 'success', #{reason}, #{afterHash})
